title: Northgate Card Payment Acceptance Schedule
content:
This schedule lists, card by card, how payments on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account are accepted and credited, and the figures that govern a credit balance.

## Payment acceptance

| Card | Channels in which payments are accepted | Largest single cash payment at a Northgate register | Automatic payment amounts the cardholder can choose | Payment cutoff time (Eastern) on a business day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card | online, app, phone, in store, mail, automatic payment | 1000.00 USD | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | 17:00 |
| Northgate Store Card | online, app, phone, in store, mail, automatic payment | 1000.00 USD | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | 17:00 |
| Northgate Mastercard | online, app, phone, in store, mail, automatic payment | 1000.00 USD | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | 17:00 |
| Northgate World Mastercard | online, app, phone, in store, mail, automatic payment | 1000.00 USD | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | 17:00 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | online, app, phone, mail, automatic payment | not applicable (in-store payment is not offered) | minimum due, statement balance | 17:00 |
| Northgate Business Mastercard | online, app, phone, mail, automatic payment | not applicable (in-store payment is not offered) | minimum due, statement balance | 17:00 |

**How the part of a payment above the minimum is allocated:** highest APR first, on every card.

A payment must be received by 17:00 Eastern on a business day to be credited that day. Hypothetical illustration: a payment received at 16:40 Eastern on a business day is credited that day; one received at 17:20 is credited on the next business day.

## Credit balance figures

| Figure | Every card |
|---|---|
| Credit balance above which a refund is made on request | 1.00 USD |
| Business days after a written request within which a credit balance above the minimum is refunded | 7 |
| Months after which a remaining credit balance above the minimum is refunded without a request | 6 |
